tor.text: Balthor Rockfist is zombified by Braids in revenge for Leer, and the Cabalists raise him as Balthor the Defiled, who hunts Laquatus.
Laquatus controls Balthor and forces him to fight Kamahl, and Balthor begs to be killed, so Kamahl does.

jud.text: Balthor and Jeska try to separate the Mirari from Kamahl for fear of its corrupting influence, and Jeska says that she and her brother both come from Balthor's forge.
Attacked at the edge of the Krosan forest, Balthor sacrifices himself so that Kamahl can flee with Jeska.
Laquatus later mind-controls the zombified Balthor into fighting Kamahl, who is forced to strike down his old mentor at Balthor's plea.
Balthor's spirit guides Kamahl to the Mirari-sword and is struck down by it for the last time, bringing Kamahl to his senses.
